author: Rebiz
name: Bank
install_msg: The bank slash commands are now available. Use /bank balance to get started. The core bank API (core/bank.py) must be present in your Ember installation.
short: Virtual economy slash commands — balance, transfer, leaderboard, and admin controls.
description: Exposes the Ember core bank API as slash commands. Provides /bank balance, /bank transfer, /bank leaderboard, and admin commands for managing currency names, max balances, and deposits/withdrawals. Requires core/bank.py in the base Ember install.
